warning: Planning estimate only, not electrical design or a safety certificate. The piecewise Peukert extension assumes constant voltage, known battery-input watts, no recovery, stable temperature and a suitable measured exponent. It is mainly a lead-acid approximation, not a lithium BMS model. It omits surge power, voltage sag, wiring/inverter ratings, aging and thermal effects. Held loads are excluded, so this plan may be incomplete. A lower required Ah is not universally better or a promise of runtime. Verify manufacturer discharge curves and obtain qualified advice before use; never use this for life-critical loads. No equipment is controlled.
